source.text: וַתָּשֻׁ֨בוּ אַתֶּ֜ם הַיּ֗וֹם וַתַּעֲשׂ֤וּ אֶת־הַיָּשָׁר֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י לִקְרֹ֥א דְר֖וֹר אִ֣ישׁ לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ וַתִּכְרְת֤וּ בְרִית֙ לְפָנַ֔י בַּבַּ֕יִת אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמִ֖י עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And turned you today, and you did the right in my eyes, to proclaim liberty each to his neighbor; and you made [a] covenant before me in the house which is called my name on it.

en.L: And you turned today and did what is right in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes, by proclaiming liberty, each to his neighbor; and you made a covenant before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in the house that is called by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.B: Just now you yourselves turned back and did what is right in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight: each of you announced freedom for your neighbor, and you made a covenant in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence in the house that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.R: Just now you changed your ways and did what I say is right. Each of you announced freedom for your neighbor. You made a covenant in front of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, in the temple that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes se habían vuelto|vosotros os habíais vuelto}} hoy, y {{plural_you:habían hecho|habíais hecho}} lo recto ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos, proclamando libertad cada uno a su prójimo; e {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} pacto delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la casa que es llamada por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.B: Hace poco {{plural_you:ustedes mismos se volvieron|vosotros mismos os volvisteis}} e {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} lo recto ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos: cada uno anunció la libertad para su prójimo, e {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} un pacto en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia, en la casa que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.R: Hace poco {{plural_you:ustedes cambiaron|vosotros cambiasteis}} de conducta e {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} lo que yo considero recto. Cada uno anunció la libertad para su prójimo. {{plural_you:Hicieron|Hicisteis}} un pacto delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, en el templo que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.

fr.L: Et vous, vous étiez revenus aujourd’hui, et vous aviez fait ce qui est droit à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, en proclamant la liberté chacun à son prochain ; et vous aviez conclu une alliance devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dans la maison sur laquelle {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est invoqué.
fr.B: Vous-mêmes, tout récemment, vous étiez revenus à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et vous aviez fait ce qui est droit à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux : chacun de vous avait annoncé la libération de son prochain, et vous aviez conclu une alliance en {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} présence, dans la maison qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.
fr.R: Tout récemment, vous aviez changé de conduite et fait ce que je considère comme juste. Chacun de vous avait annoncé la libération de son prochain. Vous aviez fait une alliance devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dans le temple qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.

sw.L: Nanyi mligeuka leo, mkatenda yaliyo sawa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, kwa kumtangazia kila mtu jirani yake uhuru; nanyi mlifanya agano mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika nyumba iitwayo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.B: Hivi karibuni ninyi wenyewe mligeuka, mkatenda yaliyo sawa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}: kila mmoja wenu alimtangazia jirani yake uhuru, nanyi mkafanya agano mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika nyumba iitwayo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.R: Hivi karibuni mlibadili njia zenu, mkatenda yale ninayoyaona kuwa sawa. Kila mmoja wenu alimtangazia jirani yake uhuru. Mlifanya agano mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, katika hekalu linaloitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.

vi.L: Còn các ngươi, hôm nay các ngươi đã quay lại và làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt Ta, là công bố sự tự do, mỗi người cho người lân cận mình; và các ngươi đã lập giao ước trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong nhà được gọi bằng danh Ta.
vi.B: Mới đây chính các ngươi đã quay lại và làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt Ta: mỗi người đã công bố sự giải phóng cho người lân cận mình, và các ngươi đã lập giao ước trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong nhà mang danh Ta.
vi.R: Mới đây các ngươi đã thay đổi cách sống và làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} coi là đúng. Mỗi người trong các ngươi đã công bố trả tự do cho người lân cận mình. Các ngươi đã lập giao ước trước mặt Ta, trong đền thờ mang danh Ta.

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 오늘 돌이켜 내 눈에 옳은 일을 행하여, 각자 자기 이웃에게 자유를 선포했고, 내 이름으로 불리는 집에서 내 앞에서 언약을 맺었다.
ko.B: 바로 얼마 전에 너희는 돌이켜 내가 보기에 옳은 일을 했다. 너희가 저마다 이웃에게 해방을 선포했고, 내 이름으로 불리는 집에서 내 앞에서 언약을 맺었다.
ko.R: 바로 얼마 전에 너희는 마음을 바꾸어 내가 옳다고 하는 일을 했다. 너희는 저마다 이웃을 풀어 주겠다고 선포했다. 너희는 내 이름으로 불리는 성전에서 내 앞에서 언약을 맺었다.

pt.L: E vocês voltaram hoje e fizeram o que é reto aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos, proclamando liberdade, cada um ao seu próximo; e fizeram uma aliança diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} na casa que é chamada pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome.
pt.B: Ainda há pouco vocês mesmos voltaram atrás e fizeram o que é reto aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos: cada um de vocês proclamou liberdade para o seu próximo, e fizeram uma aliança na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} presença, na casa que leva o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome.
pt.R: Ainda há pouco vocês mudaram de vida e fizeram o que eu digo que é certo. Cada um de vocês anunciou liberdade para o seu próximo. Vocês fizeram uma aliança diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, no templo que leva o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome.

am.L: እናንተም ዛሬ ተመለሳችሁ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም ለባልንጀራችሁ ነጻነትን በማወጅ በዓይኔ ፊት ቅን የሆነውን አደረጋችሁ፤ ስሜም በተጠራበት ቤት በፊቴ ቃል ኪዳን አደረጋችሁ።
am.B: እናንተ ራሳችሁ በቅርቡ ተመለሳችሁ፤ በፊቴም ቅን የሆነውን አደረጋችሁ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁ ለባልንጀራችሁ ነጻነትን አወጃችሁ፤ ስሜ በሚጠራበት ቤትም በፊቴ ቃል ኪዳን አደረጋችሁ።
am.R: በቅርቡ መንገዳችሁን ለወጣችሁ፤ እኔ ትክክል ነው የምለውንም አደረጋችሁ። እያንዳንዳችሁ ለባልንጀራችሁ ነጻነትን አወጃችሁ። ስሜ በሚጠራበት ቤተ መቅደስ በፊቴ ቃል ኪዳን አደረጋችሁ።

hi.L: और तुम आज फिर गए थे, और तुमने वह किया जो मेरी दृष्टि में ठीक है, अर्थात हर एक ने अपने पड़ोसी के लिए छुटकारे का प्रचार किया; और तुमने उस भवन में जो मेरे नाम से कहलाता है, मेरे सामने वाचा बाँधी।
hi.B: अभी हाल ही में तुम स्वयं लौटे थे और तुमने वह किया जो मेरी दृष्टि में ठीक है: तुम में से हर एक ने अपने पड़ोसी के लिए स्वतंत्रता की घोषणा की, और तुमने उस भवन में जो मेरे नाम का है, मेरे सामने वाचा बाँधी।
hi.R: अभी हाल ही में तुमने अपना चालचलन बदला था और वह किया था जिसे मैं ठीक कहता हूँ। तुम में से हर एक ने अपने पड़ोसी के लिए आज़ादी की घोषणा की। तुमने मेरे सामने, उस मन्दिर में जो मेरे नाम का है, वाचा बाँधी।

ru.L: А вы сегодня обратились и сделали правое в {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глазах, объявив свободу каждый своему ближнему, и заключили завет передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} в доме, над которым наречено {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя.
ru.B: Совсем недавно вы обратились и сделали то, что правильно в {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глазах: каждый из вас объявил свободу своему ближнему, и вы заключили завет передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} в доме, который носит {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя.
ru.R: Совсем недавно вы изменили свой путь и сделали то, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} считаю правильным. Каждый из вас объявил свободу своему ближнему. Вы заключили завет передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} в храме, который носит {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя.

ja.L: あなたがたは今日、立ち帰って、わたしの目に正しいことを行い、各自が自分の隣人に解放を宣言し、わたしの名で呼ばれている家で、わたしの前で契約を結んだ。
ja.B: あなたがたは、つい先ごろ立ち帰って、わたしの目に正しいとされることを行った。各自が自分の隣人に解放を宣言し、わたしの名がつけられた家で、わたしの前で契約を結んだのだ。
ja.R: あなたたちは、ついこの間、わたしのもとに戻って来て、わたしが正しいと言うことをした。それぞれ、自分の隣の人に自由を与えると告げた。そして、わたしの名がつけられた神殿で、わたしの前で契約を結んだ。

uk.L: А ви сьогодні навернулися і зробили правильне в {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} очах, оголосивши волю кожен своєму ближньому; і ви уклали завіт переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}} в домі, що називається {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям.
uk.B: Щойно ви самі навернулися й зробили правильне в {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} очах: кожен з вас оголосив волю своєму ближньому, і ви уклали завіт переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}} в домі, що носить {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя.
uk.R: Щойно ви змінилися й зробили те, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} називаю правильним. Кожен з вас оголосив волю своєму ближньому. Ви уклали завіт переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}, у храмі, що носить {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя.

id.L: Dan kalian hari ini telah berbalik dan melakukan apa yang benar di mata-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, dengan memaklumkan pembebasan, masing-masing kepada sesamanya; dan kalian telah mengadakan perjanjian di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} di rumah yang disebut dengan nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.B: Baru saja kalian sendiri berbalik dan melakukan apa yang benar di mata-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}: masing-masing kalian memaklumkan pembebasan bagi sesamanya, dan kalian mengadakan perjanjian di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} di rumah yang menyandang nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.R: Baru saja kalian bertobat dan melakukan apa yang {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} anggap benar. Masing-masing kalian mengumumkan kebebasan bagi sesamanya. Kalian membuat perjanjian di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, di rumah-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang memakai nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.

tl.L: At kayo ay nanumbalik ngayon at ginawa ang tama sa aking paningin, sa pagpapahayag ng kalayaan, bawat isa sa kaniyang kapuwa; at nakipagtipan kayo sa harap ko sa bahay na tinatawag sa aking pangalan.
tl.B: Kamakailan lamang ay nanumbalik kayo at ginawa ang tama sa aking paningin: nagpahayag ang bawat isa sa inyo ng kalayaan para sa kaniyang kapuwa, at nakipagtipan kayo sa harap ko sa bahay na tinatawag sa aking pangalan.
tl.R: Kamakailan lamang ay binago ninyo ang inyong mga gawi at ginawa ang sinasabi kong tama. Ipinahayag ng bawat isa sa inyo ang kalayaan ng kaniyang kapuwa. Nakipagtipan kayo sa harap ko, sa templong tinatawag sa aking pangalan.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਅੱਜ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੁੜੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਕੀਤਾ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਠੀਕ ਹੈ, ਕਿ ਹਰੇਕ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਲਈ ਛੁਟਕਾਰੇ ਦੀ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਕੀਤੀ; ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਭਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਤੋਂ ਸਦਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਨੇਮ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿਆ।
pa.B: ਹੁਣੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪ ਮੁੜੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਕੀਤਾ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਿਗਾਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਠੀਕ ਹੈ: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਲਈ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ ਦਾ ਐਲਾਨ ਕੀਤਾ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਭਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨੇਮ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿਆ।
pa.R: ਹੁਣੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣਾ ਚਾਲ-ਚਲਣ ਬਦਲਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਮੈਂ ਠੀਕ ਆਖਦਾ ਹਾਂ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਦੀ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ ਦਾ ਐਲਾਨ ਕੀਤਾ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਉਸ ਮੰਦਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਨੇਮ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿਆ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਲ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

zh.L: 你们今日回转，做了我眼中看为正的事，各人向邻舍宣告自由；你们又在称为我名下的殿中，在我面前立了约。
zh.B: 就在最近，你们自己回转，做了我看为正的事：你们各人向邻舍宣告自由，又在我面前，在那称为我名下的殿中立了约。
zh.R: 不久以前，你们改变了做法，做了我认为对的事。你们每个人都向邻舍宣告自由。你们在我面前，在称为我名下的圣殿里立了约。

decisions.choice: you turned today: you repented recently
decisions.reason: "Today" here means "just now", in these recent days. "Turned" is the word used for turning back to God, repenting; the next verse uses it again for turning away (verse 11 m2).

decisions.choice: his neighbor: a fellow Israelite held as a slave
decisions.reason: The slave is called the owner's "neighbor", a member of the same people, as "brother" in verses 9 and 14.

decisions.choice: the house called by my name: the temple
decisions.reason: The covenant was sworn in the temple, before the LORD, which made the oath all the more binding. The same phrase is used of the temple in 7:10-11.

decisions.choice: Just now
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "today" means here (m1).

decisions.choice: the temple
decisions.reason: Readable names the house as the temple (m3).

decisions.choice: "quay lại" (turned)
decisions.reason: Their turning to do right is repentance, so it takes the terms note's "quay lại" family for shuv; verse 16 uses the same verb for their turning away again.

decisions.choice: совсем недавно (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Today" here means "just now", a recent turn (meaning m1); Literal keeps "сегодня".

decisions.choice: wattashuvu (34:15) and wattashuvu (34:16) are one verb, turning to God and turning back: "立ち帰って…[再び]向きを変えて" (L), "立ち帰って…再び背を向けて" (B), "わたしのもとに戻って来て…またわたしに背を向けて" (R), the JER shuv pair.
decisions.reason: m1; JER conventions for shuv.

decisions.choice: habbayit 'asher niqra' shemi 'alav "わたしの名で呼ばれている家" (L), "わたしの名がつけられた家" (B), "…神殿" (R), as 7:10; "right in my eyes" in the 7:30 pattern.
decisions.reason: JER-2 forms.

decisions.choice: "nanumbalik ngayon"
decisions.reason: You turned today: you repented recently (m1).

decisions.choice: "就在最近" (B); "不久以前" (R)
decisions.reason: "Today" here means just now, recently (m1); Literal keeps "今日".

alignments.target_span: わたしの名がつけられた

source.text: וַתָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ וַתְּחַלְּל֣וּ אֶת־שְׁמִ֔י וַתָּשִׁ֗בוּ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־עַבְדּוֹ֙ וְאִ֣ישׁ אֶת־שִׁפְחָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־שִׁלַּחְתֶּ֥ם חָפְשִׁ֖ים לְנַפְשָׁ֑ם וַתִּכְבְּשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֔ם לִֽהְי֣וֹת לָכֶ֔ם לַעֲבָדִ֖ים וְלִשְׁפָחֽוֹת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But you turned and you profaned my name, and you brought back each his male slave and each his female slave whom you had sent away free to their desire, and you subjected them to be for you as male slaves and as female slaves.

en.L: But then you turned and profaned {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and you brought back, each his male slave and each his female slave whom you had sent away free as they desired, and you subjected them to be male slaves and female slaves for you.
en.B: But then you turned around and profaned {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. Each of you took back the male and female slaves you had set free to go where they wished, and you forced them to be your slaves again.
en.R: But then you turned around and dishonored {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. Each of you took back the slaves you had freed to live as they wanted. You forced them to be your slaves again.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:se volvieron|os volvisteis}} y {{plural_you:profanaron|profanasteis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, e {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} volver cada uno a su esclavo y cada uno a su esclava, a quienes {{plural_you:habían dejado|habíais dejado}} libres a su voluntad, y los {{plural_you:sometieron|sometisteis}} a ser {{plural_you:sus esclavos y sus esclavas|vuestros esclavos y vuestras esclavas}}.
es.B: Pero luego {{plural_you:se volvieron|os volvisteis}} atrás y {{plural_you:profanaron|profanasteis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Cada uno volvió a tomar a los esclavos y esclavas que {{plural_you:habían dejado|habíais dejado}} libres para ir adonde quisieran, y los {{plural_you:obligaron|obligasteis}} a ser {{plural_you:sus esclavos|vuestros esclavos}} otra vez.
es.R: Pero luego {{plural_you:se volvieron|os volvisteis}} atrás y {{plural_you:deshonraron|deshonrasteis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Cada uno volvió a tomar a los esclavos que {{plural_you:habían liberado|habíais liberado}} para que vivieran como quisieran. Los {{plural_you:obligaron|obligasteis}} a ser {{plural_you:sus esclavos|vuestros esclavos}} otra vez.

fr.L: Mais vous êtes revenus [en arrière] et vous avez profané {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et vous avez fait revenir chacun son esclave et chacun sa servante, que vous aviez renvoyés libres selon leur désir, et vous les avez asservis pour qu’ils soient vos esclaves et vos servantes.
fr.B: Mais ensuite vous avez fait volte-face et profané {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Chacun de vous a repris les esclaves, hommes et femmes, qu’il avait libérés pour qu’ils aillent où ils voulaient, et vous les avez forcés à redevenir vos esclaves.
fr.R: Mais ensuite, vous avez fait volte-face et vous avez déshonoré {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Chacun de vous a repris les esclaves qu’il avait libérés pour qu’ils vivent comme ils voulaient. Vous les avez obligés à redevenir vos esclaves.

sw.L: Lakini mligeuka, mkalinajisi jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, mkawarudisha kila mtu mtumwa wake wa kiume na kila mtu mtumwa wake wa kike mliokuwa mmewaacha huru kama walivyotaka, mkawatiisha wawe kwenu watumwa wa kiume na watumwa wa kike.
sw.B: Lakini kisha mligeuka, mkalinajisi jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Kila mmoja wenu aliwarudisha watumwa wa kiume na wa kike aliokuwa amewaacha huru waende watakako, nanyi mkawalazimisha kuwa watumwa wenu tena.
sw.R: Lakini kisha mligeuka mkalivunjia heshima jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Kila mmoja wenu aliwarudisha watumwa aliokuwa amewaachilia waishi watakavyo. Mliwalazimisha kuwa watumwa wenu tena.

vi.L: Nhưng rồi các ngươi lại quay đi và làm ô danh Ta, mỗi người bắt về nô lệ nam và nô lệ nữ của mình mà các ngươi đã thả cho tự do theo ý họ, và cưỡng ép họ làm nô lệ nam và nô lệ nữ cho các ngươi.
vi.B: Nhưng rồi các ngươi lại quay đi và làm ô danh Ta. Mỗi người đã bắt lại những nô lệ nam nữ mà các ngươi đã trả tự do để họ đi đâu tùy ý, và cưỡng ép họ làm nô lệ cho các ngươi trở lại.
vi.R: Nhưng rồi các ngươi lại quay đi và làm nhục danh Ta. Mỗi người đã bắt lại những nô lệ mà các ngươi đã trả tự do để họ sống theo ý mình. Các ngươi đã buộc họ làm nô lệ cho các ngươi trở lại.

ko.L: 그러나 너희는 돌아서서 내 이름을 더럽혔다. 너희는 각자 원하는 대로 자유롭게 놓아주었던 자기 남종과 여종을 다시 데려와서, 그들을 너희의 남종과 여종이 되게 굴복시켰다.
ko.B: 그러나 너희는 다시 돌아서서 내 이름을 더럽혔다. 너희는 저마다 마음대로 가게 놓아주었던 남종과 여종을 다시 데려와서 강제로 너희의 종으로 삼았다.
ko.R: 그런데 너희는 다시 돌아서서 내 이름을 욕되게 했다. 너희는 저마다 마음대로 살게 풀어 주었던 종들을 다시 데려왔다. 너희는 그들을 억지로 다시 너희의 종으로 삼았다.

pt.L: Mas depois vocês voltaram atrás e profanaram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, e trouxeram de volta, cada um o seu escravo e cada um a sua escrava, que tinham despedido livres segundo o desejo deles, e os sujeitaram a serem para vocês escravos e escravas.
pt.B: Mas depois vocês deram meia-volta e profanaram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome. Cada um de vocês pegou de volta os escravos e as escravas que tinham libertado para irem aonde quisessem, e vocês os obrigaram a ser seus escravos de novo.
pt.R: Mas depois vocês deram meia-volta e desonraram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome. Cada um de vocês pegou de volta os escravos que tinha libertado para viverem como quisessem. Vocês os obrigaram a ser escravos de vocês outra vez.

am.L: ነገር ግን ተመለሳችሁ፤ ስሜንም አቃለላችሁ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም እንደ ፈቃዳቸው ነጻ አድርጋችሁ የለቀቃችኋቸውን ወንድ ባሪያችሁንና ሴት ባሪያችሁን መለሳችሁ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም ይሆኑላችሁ ዘንድ ገዛችኋቸው።
am.B: ነገር ግን እንደ ገና ተመለሳችሁ፤ ስሜንም አቃለላችሁ። እያንዳንዳችሁ ወደ ፈለጉበት እንዲሄዱ ነጻ ያወጣችኋቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎች መልሳችሁ ወሰዳችሁ፤ እንደ ገናም ባሪያዎቻችሁ እንዲሆኑ አስገደዳችኋቸው።
am.R: ነገር ግን እንደ ገና ተመለሳችሁ፤ ስሜንም አዋረዳችሁ። እያንዳንዳችሁ እንደ ፈለጉ እንዲኖሩ ነጻ ያወጣችኋቸውን ባሪያዎች መልሳችሁ ወሰዳችሁ። እንደ ገናም ባሪያዎቻችሁ እንዲሆኑ አስገደዳችኋቸው።

hi.L: पर फिर तुम फिर गए और तुमने मेरे नाम को अपवित्र किया, और तुम में से हर एक अपने उस दास को और हर एक अपनी उस दासी को लौटा लाया जिन्हें तुमने उनकी इच्छा के अनुसार स्वतंत्र करके विदा किया था, और तुमने उन्हें दबा लिया कि वे तुम्हारे दास और दासियाँ बनें।
hi.B: पर फिर तुम पलट गए और तुमने मेरे नाम को अपवित्र किया। तुम में से हर एक उन दास-दासियों को वापस ले आया जिन्हें तुमने स्वतंत्र कर दिया था कि जहाँ चाहें जाएँ, और तुमने उन्हें फिर से अपने दास बनने को विवश किया।
hi.R: पर फिर तुम पलट गए और तुमने मेरे नाम का अनादर किया। तुम में से हर एक उन दासों को वापस ले आया जिन्हें तुमने आज़ाद कर दिया था कि वे अपनी इच्छा से जिएँ। तुमने उन्हें फिर से अपने दास बनने को मजबूर किया।

ru.L: Но вы повернули назад и осквернили {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя, и вернули каждый своего раба и каждый свою рабыню, которых вы отпустили на свободу по их желанию, и принудили их быть у вас рабами и рабынями.
ru.B: Но потом вы повернули назад и осквернили {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя. Каждый из вас забрал назад рабов и рабынь, которых отпустил на свободу, чтобы они жили, где хотят, и вы заставили их снова стать вашими рабами.
ru.R: Но потом вы повернули назад и обесчестили {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя. Каждый из вас забрал назад рабов, которых освободил, чтобы они жили, как хотят. Вы заставили их снова стать вашими рабами.

ja.L: しかし、あなたがたは[再び]向きを変えて、わたしの名を汚し、各自が、思いのままに自由の身として去らせた自分の男奴隷と女奴隷を連れ戻し、彼らを服従させて、あなたがたの男奴隷と女奴隷にした。
ja.B: しかし、あなたがたは再び背を向けて、わたしの名を汚した。各自、思いのままに行けるよう自由にした男女の奴隷を連れ戻し、無理やり再び自分たちの奴隷にした。
ja.R: ところが、あなたたちは、またわたしに背を向けて、わたしの名をけがした。それぞれ、自由に生きられるようにした奴隷たちを連れ戻し、無理やり、もう一度奴隷にした。

uk.L: Але потім ви відвернулися і зневажили {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, і повернули кожен свого раба і кожен свою рабиню, яких відпустили на волю, куди вони хотіли, і поневолили їх, щоб вони були вам рабами й рабинями.
uk.B: Але потім ви знову відвернулися і зневажили {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя. Кожен з вас забрав назад рабів і рабинь, яких ви відпустили, щоб ішли, куди хочуть, і ви змусили їх знову бути вашими рабами.
uk.R: Але потім ви відвернулися й збезчестили {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя. Кожен з вас забрав назад рабів, яких звільнив, щоб вони жили, як хочуть. Ви змусили їх знову стати вашими рабами.

id.L: Tetapi kemudian kalian berbalik dan menajiskan nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, dan kalian mengambil kembali, masing-masing budaknya laki-laki dan masing-masing budaknya perempuan yang telah kalian lepaskan sebagai orang merdeka sesuai dengan keinginan mereka, dan kalian menundukkan mereka menjadi budak laki-laki dan budak perempuan bagi kalian.
id.B: Tetapi kemudian kalian berbalik dan mencemarkan nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Masing-masing kalian mengambil kembali budak-budak laki-laki dan perempuan yang telah kalian merdekakan untuk pergi ke mana mereka mau, dan kalian memaksa mereka menjadi budak kalian lagi.
id.R: Tetapi kemudian kalian berbalik dan menghina nama-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Masing-masing kalian mengambil kembali budak-budak yang telah kalian merdekakan untuk hidup sesuai keinginan mereka. Kalian memaksa mereka menjadi budak kalian lagi.

tl.L: Ngunit pagkatapos ay bumalik kayo at nilapastangan ang aking pangalan, at ibinalik ng bawat isa ang kaniyang aliping lalaki at ang bawat isa ang kaniyang aliping babae na inyong pinalaya ayon sa kanilang nais, at sapilitan ninyo silang ginawang mga aliping lalaki at babae para sa inyo.
tl.B: Ngunit pagkatapos ay tumalikod kayo at nilapastangan ang aking pangalan. Binawi ng bawat isa sa inyo ang mga aliping lalaki at babae na pinalaya ninyo upang pumunta kung saan nila nais, at pinilit ninyo silang maging alipin ninyo muli.
tl.R: Ngunit pagkatapos ay tumalikod kayo at niyurakan ang aking pangalan. Binawi ng bawat isa sa inyo ang mga aliping pinalaya ninyo upang mamuhay ayon sa kanilang nais. Pinilit ninyo silang maging alipin ninyo muli.

pa.L: ਪਰ ਫੇਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੁੜ ਗਏ ਅਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਭ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟ ਕੀਤਾ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਨੂੰ ਅਤੇ ਹਰੇਕ ਆਪਣੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਨੂੰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਮਰਜ਼ੀ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਅਜ਼ਾਦ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਸੀ ਮੋੜ ਲਿਆਏ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਸੀਆਂ ਬਣਨ ਲਈ ਮਜਬੂਰ ਕੀਤਾ।
pa.B: ਪਰ ਫੇਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪਲਟ ਗਏ ਅਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਭ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟ ਕੀਤਾ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਨੇ ਉਹ ਦਾਸ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਸੀਆਂ ਵਾਪਸ ਲੈ ਲਏ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਚਾਹੁਣ ਜਾਣ ਲਈ ਅਜ਼ਾਦ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਫੇਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਬਣਨ ਲਈ ਮਜਬੂਰ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ।
pa.R: ਪਰ ਫੇਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪਲਟ ਗਏ ਅਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਨਿਰਾਦਰ ਕੀਤਾ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਨੇ ਉਹ ਗ਼ੁਲਾਮ ਮੁੜ ਲੈ ਲਏ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਮਰਜ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਜੀਉਣ ਲਈ ਅਜ਼ਾਦ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੀ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜ਼ਬਰਦਸਤੀ ਫੇਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਗ਼ੁਲਾਮ ਬਣਾ ਲਿਆ।

zh.L: 但你们又反过来亵渎我的名，各人把你们已经让他们随意自由离去的男奴和女奴带回来，强迫他们给你们作男奴和女奴。
zh.B: 但后来你们又反过来亵渎我的名。你们各人把已经释放、任他们随意去哪里的男女奴隶抓回来，强迫他们再给你们作奴隶。
zh.R: 但后来你们又反过来羞辱我的名。你们各人把已经释放、让他们自由生活的奴隶抓了回来，强迫他们再给你们作奴隶。

decisions.choice: profaned my name: dishonored the LORD by breaking an oath sworn in his name
decisions.reason: The covenant was sworn before the LORD in his temple (verse 15). To break it was to treat his name as worthless, as Leviticus 19:12 warns: "You shall not swear falsely by my name, and so profane the name of your God."

decisions.choice: to their desire: free to go where they chose
decisions.reason: The phrase, literally "to their soul", means as they themselves wished, as in Deuteronomy 21:14. The freed slaves had been their own masters.

decisions.choice: subjected: brought under force
decisions.reason: The verb means to subdue or press down, used of conquering a land (Joshua 18:1) and of forcing people into slavery (Nehemiah 5:5).

decisions.choice: slave at every level
decisions.reason: As in verse 9: slavery itself is the point of the passage.

decisions.choice: dishonored
decisions.reason: Readable says "dishonored" for the less common word "profaned".

decisions.choice: "돌이키다" (verse 15) and "돌아서다" (verse 16) for the same verb *shuv*
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "돌아오다/돌이키다" for turning to God and "돌아서다" for turning away; Korean shows by the two words that the people turned twice, first to God and then away.

decisions.choice: ḥillel "ማቃለል" (Literal, Balanced), "ማዋረድ" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled words for profane.

decisions.choice: अपवित्र करना (L, B); अनादर करना (R)
decisions.reason: To profane God's name is to dishonour it by breaking an oath sworn in it (m1); Readable says अनादर, as the English says "dishonored".

decisions.choice: обесчестили (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word for dishonouring the LORD's name by breaking an oath sworn in it (meaning m1); Literal and Balanced keep "осквернили".

decisions.choice: chillel shemi "わたしの名を汚す" (L, B), "わたしの名をけがす" (R).
decisions.reason: m1: dishonoring the LORD by breaking an oath sworn in his name.

decisions.choice: "nilapastangan ang aking pangalan"
decisions.reason: Dishonored the LORD by breaking an oath sworn in his name (m1).

decisions.choice: ਭ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟ ਕਰਨਾ (L, B); ਨਿਰਾਦਰ ਕਰਨਾ (R)
decisions.reason: Profaning the name.

decisions.choice: "亵渎" (L, B); "羞辱" (R)
decisions.reason: Breaking an oath sworn in the LORD's name profanes it (m1); Readable says "羞辱", as its English says "dishonored".

alignments.target_span: 思いのままに行けるよう
無理やり再び自分たちの奴隷にした

source.text: לָכֵן֮ כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ אַתֶּם֙ לֹֽא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם אֵלַ֔י לִקְרֹ֣א דְר֔וֹר אִ֥ישׁ לְאָחִ֖יו וְאִ֣ישׁ לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ הִנְנִ֣י קֹרֵא֩ לָכֶ֨ם דְּר֜וֹר נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־הַחֶ֨רֶב֙ אֶל־הַדֶּ֣בֶר וְאֶל־הָרָעָ֔ב וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ לְזַעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh: You not listened to me to proclaim liberty each to his brother and each to his neighbor; look I [am] proclaiming to you liberty, declaration of Yahweh, to the sword, to the pestilence and to the famine; and I will make you for a horror to all [the] kingdoms of the earth.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: You have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} by proclaiming liberty, each to his brother and each to his neighbor. Look, I am proclaiming liberty to you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to the sword, to the pestilence and to the famine; and I will make you a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: You have not obeyed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} by announcing freedom, each of you for your fellow Hebrew and your neighbor. So now I am announcing freedom for you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: freedom to fall by the sword, the plague and the famine. I will make you a horror to every kingdom on earth.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: You did not obey {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. You did not give freedom to your own people and your neighbors. So now I will give you freedom, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: freedom to die by war, disease and famine! I will make you something that horrifies every kingdom on earth.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Ustedes no me han|Vosotros no me habéis}} escuchado para proclamar libertad cada uno a su hermano y cada uno a su prójimo. He aquí, yo {{plural_you:les|os}} proclamo libertad, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, a la espada, a la peste y al hambre; y {{plural_you:los|os}} pondré por horror a todos los reinos de la tierra.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: {{plural_you:Ustedes no me han|Vosotros no me habéis}} obedecido, pues no {{plural_you:anunciaron|anunciasteis}} la libertad cada uno para su compatriota hebreo y para su prójimo. Así que ahora yo anuncio libertad para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: libertad para caer por la espada, la peste y el hambre. Haré de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} un horror para todos los reinos de la tierra.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Ustedes no me obedecieron|Vosotros no me obedecisteis}}. No {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} libertad a {{plural_you:su propia gente ni a sus prójimos|vuestra propia gente ni a vuestros prójimos}}. Así que ahora yo {{plural_you:les|os}} daré libertad, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: ¡libertad para morir en la guerra, de enfermedad y de hambre! Haré que todos los reinos de la tierra se horroricen al {{plural_you:verlos|veros}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas écouté pour proclamer la liberté chacun à son frère et chacun à son prochain. Voici, je proclame pour vous la liberté, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [la liberté] pour l’épée, pour la peste et pour la famine ; et je ferai de vous une horreur pour tous les royaumes de la terre.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas obéi en annonçant la libération, chacun pour son compatriote et pour son prochain. Eh bien, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, j’annonce pour vous la libération, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : la libération qui vous livre à l’épée, à la peste et à la famine. Je ferai de vous un objet d’horreur pour tous les royaumes de la terre.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas obéi. Vous n’avez pas libéré les gens de votre propre peuple ni vos voisins. Alors maintenant, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui vous libère, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : je vous libère pour que vous mouriez par la guerre, la maladie et la famine ! Je ferai de vous quelque chose qui horrifiera tous les royaumes de la terre.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Ninyi hamkunisikiliza kwa kutangaza uhuru, kila mtu kwa ndugu yake na kila mtu kwa jirani yake. Tazama, ninawatangazia ninyi uhuru, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa upanga, kwa tauni na kwa njaa; nami nitawafanya kuwa kitisho kwa falme zote za dunia.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Hamkunitii kwa kutangaza uhuru, kila mmoja kwa Mwebrania mwenzake na kwa jirani yake. Basi sasa ninawatangazia ninyi uhuru, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: uhuru wa kuanguka kwa upanga, tauni na njaa. Nitawafanya kuwa kitisho kwa kila ufalme duniani.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Hamkunitii. Hamkuwapa uhuru watu wenu wenyewe na jirani zenu. Basi sasa nitawapa ninyi uhuru, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: uhuru wa kufa kwa vita, magonjwa na njaa! Nitawafanya kuwa kitu kinachotisha kila ufalme duniani.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Các ngươi đã không nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà công bố sự tự do, mỗi người cho anh em mình và mỗi người cho người lân cận mình. Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} công bố sự tự do cho các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, [tự do] cho gươm, cho ôn dịch và cho nạn đói; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các ngươi thành một điều kinh hoàng cho mọi vương quốc trên đất.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Các ngươi đã không vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà công bố sự giải phóng, mỗi người cho đồng bào và người lân cận mình. Vậy nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} công bố sự giải phóng cho các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy: được giải phóng để ngã dưới gươm đao, dịch bệnh và nạn đói. Ta sẽ làm cho các ngươi thành một điều kinh hoàng cho mọi vương quốc trên đất.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Các ngươi đã không vâng lời Ta. Các ngươi đã không trả tự do cho đồng bào và người lân cận mình. Vậy bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi được tự do, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: tự do để chết vì chiến tranh, bệnh tật và nạn đói! Ta sẽ làm cho các ngươi thành một điều khiến mọi vương quốc trên đất đều kinh hoàng.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희가 각자 자기 형제와 자기 이웃에게 자유를 선포하라는 내 말을 듣지 않았다. 보아라, 내가 너희에게 자유를 선포한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 곧 칼과 전염병과 기근에 [넘겨지는 자유다]. 내가 너희를 세상 모든 나라에 공포가 되게 하겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희는 저마다 같은 히브리 사람과 이웃에게 해방을 선포하라는 내 말에 순종하지 않았다. 그러니 이제 내가 너희에게 해방을 선포한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 칼과 전염병과 기근에 쓰러지도록 너희를 놓아준다는 해방이다. 내가 너희를 세상 모든 나라에 공포의 대상이 되게 하겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희는 나에게 순종하지 않았다. 너희는 같은 겨레와 이웃을 풀어 주지 않았다. 그러니 이제 내가 너희를 풀어 주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 전쟁과 질병과 굶주림으로 죽도록 너희를 풀어 주겠다! 내가 너희를 세상 모든 나라가 보고 몸서리치는 대상으로 만들겠다.

pt.L: Portanto, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouviram, proclamando liberdade, cada um ao seu irmão e cada um ao seu próximo. Eis que eu proclamo para vocês liberdade, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, para a espada, para a peste e para a fome; e farei de vocês um horror para todos os reinos da terra.
pt.B: Portanto, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} obedeceram proclamando liberdade, cada um para o seu irmão hebreu e para o seu próximo. Pois agora eu proclamo liberdade para vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: liberdade para cair pela espada, pela peste e pela fome. Farei de vocês um objeto de horror para todos os reinos da terra.
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} obedeceram. Não deram liberdade ao seu próprio povo e aos seus vizinhos. Por isso agora eu vou dar liberdade a vocês, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: liberdade para morrer na guerra, de doença e de fome! Vou fazer de vocês uma coisa que horroriza todos os reinos da terra.

am.L: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እናንተ እያንዳንዳችሁ ለወንድማችሁና ለባልንጀራችሁ ነጻነትን በማወጅ አልሰማችሁኝም፤ እነሆ፣ እኔ ለሰይፍ፣ ለቸነፈርና ለራብ ነጻነትን አውጅባችኋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ለምድር መንግሥታትም ሁሉ መሸበሪያ አደርጋችኋለሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እያንዳንዳችሁ ለወገናችሁና ለባልንጀራችሁ ነጻነትን በማወጅ አልታዘዛችሁኝም። ስለዚህ እነሆ፣ እኔ ነጻነትን አውጅላችኋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ በሰይፍ፣ በቸነፈርና በራብ ለመውደቅ ነጻነትን! ለምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ መሸበሪያ አደርጋችኋለሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ አልታዘዛችሁኝም። ለገዛ ወገኖቻችሁና ለባልንጀሮቻችሁ ነጻነትን አልሰጣችሁም። ስለዚህ አሁን እኔ ነጻነትን እሰጣችኋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ በሰይፍ፣ በቸነፈርና በራብ ለመሞት ነጻነትን! የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ የሚሸበሩባችሁ አደርጋችኋለሁ።

hi.L: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: तुमने अपने अपने भाई और अपने अपने पड़ोसी के लिए छुटकारे का प्रचार करके मेरी नहीं सुनी। देखो, मैं तुम्हारे लिए छुटकारे का प्रचार करता हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, तलवार के लिए, महामारी के लिए और अकाल के लिए; और मैं तुम्हें पृथ्वी के सब राज्यों के लिए भय का कारण बना दूँगा।
hi.B: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: तुमने अपने इब्रानी भाई-बंधु और अपने पड़ोसी के लिए स्वतंत्रता की घोषणा करके मेरी बात नहीं मानी। इसलिए अब मैं तुम्हारे लिए स्वतंत्रता की घोषणा करता हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है: तलवार, महामारी और अकाल से मरने की स्वतंत्रता! मैं तुम्हें ऐसा बना दूँगा कि पृथ्वी के सब राज्य तुम्हें देखकर काँप उठें।
hi.R: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: तुमने मेरी बात नहीं मानी। तुमने अपने ही लोगों और अपने पड़ोसियों को आज़ादी नहीं दी। इसलिए अब मैं तुम्हें आज़ादी दूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं: युद्ध, बीमारी और अकाल से मरने की आज़ादी! मैं तुम्हारा ऐसा हाल करूँगा कि पृथ्वी के सब राज्य उसे देखकर सहम जाएँ।

ru.L: Поэтому так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вы не послушали {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, чтобы объявить свободу каждый своему брату и каждый своему ближнему. Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} объявляю вам свободу, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — для меча, для мора и для голода, и сделаю вас ужасом для всех царств земли.
ru.B: Поэтому так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вы не послушались {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} и не объявили свободу каждый своему соплеменнику и своему ближнему. Так вот, теперь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} объявляю свободу вам, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: свободу пасть от меча, мора и голода. Я сделаю вас ужасом для всех царств земли.
ru.R: Поэтому вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вы не послушались {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. Вы не дали свободы своим соплеменникам и ближним. Так вот, теперь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам свободу вам, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: свободу умереть от войны, болезней и голода! Все царства на земле будут в ужасе от того, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с вами сделаю.

ja.L: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたは、各自が自分の兄弟に、各自が自分の隣人に解放を宣言して、わたしに聞き従うことをしなかった。見なさい、わたしはあなたがたに解放を宣言する――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。剣に、疫病に、飢饉に[渡す解放を]。わたしはあなたがたを、地のすべての王国にとって恐怖とする。
ja.B: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたは、それぞれ同胞と隣人に解放を宣言せず、わたしに聞き従わなかった。そこで今、わたしがあなたがたに解放を宣言する、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。剣と疫病と飢饉に倒れるための解放を。わたしはあなたがたを、地のすべての王国にとって恐怖の的とする。
ja.R: だから、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたたちは、わたしに従わなかった。自分の仲間や隣の人を自由にしなかった。だから今、わたしがあなたたちに自由を与える、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。戦争と恐ろしい病気とききんで死ぬ自由だ！わたしはあなたたちを、地上のすべての王国が見て震え上がるものにする。

uk.L: Тому так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Ви не послухали {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, щоб оголосити волю кожен своєму братові і кожен своєму ближньому. Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} оголошую вам волю, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, — мечеві, моровиці й голодові; і зроблю вас жахом для всіх царств землі.
uk.B: Тому так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Ви не послухалися {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} й не оголосили волю кожен своєму братові-єврею і своєму ближньому. Тож тепер {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} оголошую волю вам, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: волю загинути від меча, пошесті й голоду. Я зроблю вас жахом для всіх царств землі.
uk.R: Тож так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Ви не послухалися {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}. Ви не дали волі своїм людям і своїм ближнім. Тож тепер {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам волю вам, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: волю загинути від війни, хвороб і голоду! Я зроблю так, що всі царства землі жахатимуться вас.

id.L: Sebab itu beginilah firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}: Kalian tidak mendengarkan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} untuk memaklumkan pembebasan, masing-masing kepada saudaranya dan masing-masing kepada sesamanya. Lihatlah, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} memaklumkan pembebasan bagi kalian, firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, kepada pedang, kepada penyakit sampar dan kepada kelaparan; dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan membuat kalian menjadi kengerian bagi segala kerajaan di bumi.
id.B: Sebab itu beginilah firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}: Kalian tidak menaati {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} dengan memaklumkan pembebasan, masing-masing bagi sesama orang Ibrani dan sesamanya. Karena itu sekarang {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} memaklumkan pembebasan bagi kalian, demikianlah firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}: pembebasan untuk mati oleh pedang, penyakit sampar dan kelaparan. Aku akan membuat kalian menjadi kengerian bagi semua kerajaan di bumi.
id.R: Jadi inilah firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}: Kalian tidak menaati {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}. Kalian tidak memberi kebebasan kepada bangsa kalian sendiri dan kepada sesama kalian. Karena itu sekarang {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan memberi kalian kebebasan, itulah firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}: kebebasan untuk mati karena perang, penyakit dan kelaparan! Aku akan membuat kalian menjadi sesuatu yang mengerikan bagi semua kerajaan di bumi.

tl.L: Kaya ganito ang sabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}: Hindi kayo nakinig sa akin sa pagpapahayag ng kalayaan, bawat isa sa kaniyang kapatid at bawat isa sa kaniyang kapuwa. Narito, nagpapahayag ako ng kalayaan para sa inyo, ang pahayag {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, tungo sa tabak, sa salot at sa taggutom; at gagawin ko kayong kakilabutan sa lahat ng kaharian sa lupa.
tl.B: Kaya ito ang sinasabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}: Hindi ninyo ako sinunod sa pagpapahayag ng kalayaan, bawat isa para sa kaniyang kapuwa Hebreo at sa kaniyang kapuwa. Kaya ngayon ay nagpapahayag ako ng kalayaan para sa inyo, ang pahayag {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}: kalayaang mamatay sa tabak, sa salot at sa taggutom. Gagawin ko kayong kakilabutan sa bawat kaharian sa lupa.
tl.R: Kaya ito ang sinasabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}: Hindi ninyo ako sinunod. Hindi ninyo binigyan ng kalayaan ang inyong mga kababayan at kapuwa. Kaya ngayon ay bibigyan ko kayo ng kalayaan, sabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}: kalayaang mamatay sa digmaan, sakit at taggutom! Gagawin ko kayong isang bagay na kinikilabutan ng bawat kaharian sa lupa.

pa.L: ਇਸ ਲਈ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਇਉਂ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੁਣੀ, ਕਿ ਹਰੇਕ ਆਪਣੇ ਭਰਾ ਲਈ ਅਤੇ ਹਰੇਕ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਲਈ ਛੁਟਕਾਰੇ ਦੀ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਕਰੇ। ਵੇਖੋ, ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਛੁਟਕਾਰੇ ਦੀ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ, {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦਾ ਵਾਕ ਹੈ, ਤਲਵਾਰ ਲਈ, ਮਹਾਂਮਾਰੀ ਲਈ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਲਈ; ਅਤੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹੀਆਂ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਭਿਆਨਕ ਨਮੂਨਾ ਬਣਾਵਾਂਗਾ।
pa.B: ਇਸ ਲਈ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਇਹ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਹਿਣਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਮੰਨਿਆ, ਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਆਪਣੇ ਇਬਰਾਨੀ ਭਰਾ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਲਈ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ ਦਾ ਐਲਾਨ ਕਰੇ। ਸੋ ਹੁਣ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ ਦਾ ਐਲਾਨ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ, {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦਾ ਵਾਕ ਹੈ: ਤਲਵਾਰ, ਮਹਾਂਮਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਨਾਲ ਮਰਨ ਦੀ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ। ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਹਰ ਰਾਜ ਲਈ ਡਰਾਉਣਾ ਨਜ਼ਾਰਾ ਬਣਾ ਦਿਆਂਗਾ।
pa.R: ਸੋ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਇਹ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੇਰੀ ਗੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਮੰਨੀ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੱਤੀ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਹੁਣ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ ਦਿਆਂਗਾ, {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਯੁੱਧ, ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਨਾਲ ਮਰਨ ਦੀ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ! ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਅਜਿਹਾ ਹਾਲ ਕਰਾਂਗਾ ਕਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਦਾ ਹਰ ਰਾਜ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਕੰਬ ਉੱਠੇ।

zh.L: 所以{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}如此说：你们没有听从我，没有各人向弟兄、各人向邻舍宣告自由。看哪，我要向你们宣告自由，这是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的宣告，[任你们]归于刀剑、瘟疫和饥荒；我要使你们成为地上万国惊骇的对象。
zh.B: 所以{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}这样说：你们没有听从我，没有各人向自己的希伯来同胞和邻舍宣告自由。现在我要向你们宣告自由，这是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的话：让你们自由地倒在刀剑、瘟疫和饥荒之下。我要使你们成为地上万国惊骇的对象。
zh.R: 所以{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说：你们没有听从我。你们没有给自己的同胞和邻舍自由。所以现在我要给你们自由，{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}说：就是死于战争、疾病和饥荒的自由！我要使你们成为让世上万国惊恐的对象。

decisions.choice: I am proclaiming liberty to you: the LORD answers their broken release with a release of his own
decisions.reason: The word for the release they took back is turned on them. Since they would not set their slaves free, the LORD sets them "free": he lets them go from his protection and gives them over to the sword, disease and famine. The punishment matches the sin in its very words.

decisions.choice: to the sword, to the pestilence, to the famine: handed over to them
decisions.reason: The word "to" says where their "freedom" takes them: they are released into the power of these three disasters.

decisions.choice: a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth: the curse of Deuteronomy 28:25
decisions.reason: As in 15:4; 24:9; 29:18, the covenant curse of Deuteronomy 28:25 comes true: what happens to them will make other nations shudder.

decisions.choice: horror: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: As in 15:4 and 24:9, the written Hebrew text spells this word with two letters in a different order, and the scribes noted the usual form in the margin to be read aloud. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the sword, the pestilence, the famine (L); the sword, the plague, the famine (B); war, disease, famine (R)
decisions.reason: The three disasters keep the wording settled for Jeremiah, in the order this verse gives them.

decisions.choice: freedom to fall by (B); freedom to die by (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat "freedom" and say what being released "to the sword" means, so that the irony is clear (m1, m2). Literal keeps the bare "to".

decisions.choice: your fellow Hebrew (B); your own people (R)
decisions.reason: "His brother" means a fellow Israelite, as in verses 9 and 14.

decisions.choice: yo les proclamo libertad (Literal); anuncio libertad para ustedes (Balanced); les daré libertad (Readable)
decisions.reason: The LORD answers their broken release with a release of his own (meaning decision m1); each level reuses its own word "libertad" from verse 8 so the irony is heard.

decisions.choice: "la libération qui vous livre à l'épée" (B); "je vous libère pour que vous mouriez par la guerre" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Balanced and Readable repeat the word of release and say what being released "to the sword" means, so that the irony is clear.

decisions.choice: the release word repeated for God's "release" to sword, plague and famine
decisions.reason: The bitter play of meaning decision m1 depends on hearing the same word, so each level repeats the word it used in verse 8 ("sự tự do" / "sự giải phóng" / "tự do").

decisions.choice: "자유를 선포하다" (L); "해방을 선포하다" (B); "풀어 주다" (R), the same words as in verses 8 and 15
alternatives: a different word for the LORD's "release"
decisions.reason: The LORD answers their broken release with a release of his own (meaning decision m1); Korean keeps the same word so the bitter play can be heard.

decisions.choice: proclamo para vocês liberdade; a espada, a peste e a fome (L, B), a guerra, a doença e a fome (R); um horror (L), objeto de horror (B)
decisions.reason: The irony (m1) needs the same word: "liberdade" repeats verses 8 and 15 at every level. The three disasters keep the words 5:12 sets for the book, in this verse's order, and the curse keeps the words of Deuteronomy 28:25 in Portuguese (m3).

decisions.choice: the three in the Hebrew order here, "ሰይፍ፣ ቸነፈርና ራብ"
decisions.reason: The terms list sets one wording for the triad; this verse has a different order in the Hebrew and the English, so the order follows them while the words stay the same.

decisions.choice: "መሸበሪያ" for the horror the nations see
decisions.reason: A sight that terrifies, as the curse of Deuteronomy 28:25.

decisions.choice: तलवार, महामारी, अकाल (L, B); युद्ध, बीमारी, अकाल (R)
decisions.reason: The three disasters keep the wording of 24:10 and 32:24, in the order this verse gives them; the horror to the kingdoms keeps the sense of Deuteronomy 28:25.

decisions.choice: मरने की स्वतंत्रता (B); मरने की आज़ादी (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat "liberty" and say what being released to the sword means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: свободу пасть от (B); свободу умереть от (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat "свободу" and say what being released "to the sword" means, so that the irony is clear (meanings m1, m2), as the English does; Literal keeps the bare "для".

decisions.choice: ужасом для всех царств земли (L, B); все царства ... будут в ужасе (R)
decisions.reason: The curse of Deuteronomy 28:25 (meaning m3) in the words that verse has in this translation at each level.

decisions.choice: The triad in the Hebrew order of this verse, sword, pestilence, famine: "剣に、疫病に、飢饉に" (L), "剣と疫病と飢饉" (B), "戦争と恐ろしい病気とききん" (R, where the English R says disease).
decisions.reason: JER conventions for the triad (14:12).

decisions.choice: qore' deror "解放を宣言する" (L, B), "自由を与える" (R), the irony kept with 34:8; za'avah "恐怖" (L), "恐怖の的" (B), as 15:4.
decisions.reason: m1: God's release answers their broken release.

decisions.choice: "pembebasan" (L, B), "kebebasan" (R) for both releases; "kengerian" (L, B), "sesuatu yang mengerikan" (R)
decisions.reason: The same word turned against them (m1); the horror as in the book's curse lists.

decisions.choice: "nagpapahayag ako ng kalayaan para sa inyo"
decisions.reason: The LORD answers their broken release with a release to death (m1).

decisions.choice: "kakilabutan"
decisions.reason: A horror to all the kingdoms of the earth: the curse of Deuteronomy 28:25 (m3).

decisions.choice: ਤਲਵਾਰ, ਮਹਾਂਮਾਰੀ, ਕਾਲ (L, B); ਯੁੱਧ, ਬਿਮਾਰੀ, ਕਾਲ (R)
decisions.reason: The judgment triad in this verse's order.

decisions.choice: ਮਰਨ ਦੀ ਅਜ਼ਾਦੀ (B, R)
decisions.reason: The irony of 'liberty' made plain.

decisions.choice: "刀剑、瘟疫和饥荒" (L, B); "战争、疾病和饥荒" (R)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's three disasters, one wording per level, in the order this verse gives them; Readable names war and disease, as its English does.

decisions.choice: "地上万国惊骇的对象" (L, B); "让世上万国惊恐的对象" (R)
decisions.reason: The curse of Deuteronomy 28:25 (m3), worded as there at Literal and Balanced.

alignments.target_span: 地のすべての王国にとって

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ אֶת־בְּרִתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־הֵקִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרְת֖וּ לְפָנָ֑י הָעֵ֨גֶל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרְת֣וּ לִשְׁנַ֔יִם וַיַּעַבְר֖וּ בֵּ֥ין בְּתָרָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make the men, the [ones] transgressing my covenant, who not they carried out [the] words of the covenant which they cut before me, the calf which they cut in two and they passed between its parts,

en.L: And I will make {{gender:the people|the men}} who transgressed {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, who did not carry out the words of the covenant that they made before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, [like] the calf that they cut in two and passed between its parts,
en.B: As for {{gender:the people|the men}} who broke {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant and did not keep the terms of the covenant they made before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will make them like the calf they cut in two and walked between its halves,
en.R: These people broke {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant. They did not keep the promises they made in front of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} when they cut a calf in two and walked between the halves. So I will make them like that calf.

es.L: Y entregaré a {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} que traspasaron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, que no cumplieron las palabras del pacto que hicieron delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, [como] al becerro que cortaron en dos y pasaron entre sus mitades,
es.B: En cuanto a {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} que quebrantaron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto y no cumplieron los términos del pacto que hicieron delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, los haré como el becerro que cortaron en dos y entre cuyas mitades pasaron,
es.R: Esta gente quebrantó {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto. No cumplieron las promesas que hicieron delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} cuando cortaron un becerro en dos y pasaron entre las mitades. Por eso los haré como a ese becerro.

fr.L: Et je livrerai {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} qui ont transgressé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, qui n’ont pas accompli les paroles de l’alliance qu’ils avaient conclue devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, [comme] le veau qu’ils ont coupé en deux et entre les morceaux duquel ils sont passés,
fr.B: Quant {{gender:aux gens|aux hommes}} qui ont violé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance et n’ont pas respecté les termes de l’alliance qu’ils avaient conclue devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je les rendrai pareils au veau qu’ils ont coupé en deux et entre les moitiés duquel ils sont passés,
fr.R: Ces gens ont violé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance. Ils n’ont pas tenu les promesses qu’ils avaient faites devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} quand ils ont coupé un veau en deux et sont passés entre les deux moitiés. Alors je les rendrai pareils à ce veau.

sw.L: Nami nitawafanya watu walioliasi agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, ambao hawakuyatimiza maneno ya agano walilofanya mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, [kama] ndama waliyemkata vipande viwili na kupita kati ya vipande vyake,
sw.B: Kuhusu watu waliolivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na kutoyashika masharti ya agano walilofanya mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, nitawafanya kama ndama waliyemkata vipande viwili na kutembea katikati ya nusu zake,
sw.R: Watu hawa walilivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Hawakutimiza ahadi walizofanya mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} walipomkata ndama vipande viwili na kutembea katikati ya nusu zake. Kwa hiyo nitawafanya kama ndama yule.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho những người đã vi phạm giao ước Ta, không làm theo những lời giao ước họ đã lập trước mặt Ta, [giống như] con bò con mà họ đã chặt làm đôi và đi qua giữa hai phần của nó,
vi.B: Còn những người đã vi phạm giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không giữ các điều khoản của giao ước họ đã lập trước mặt Ta, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho họ giống như con bò con mà họ đã chặt làm đôi rồi đi qua giữa hai nửa của nó,
vi.R: Những người này đã vi phạm giao ước Ta. Họ đã không giữ những lời hứa họ lập trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khi họ chặt một con bò con làm đôi và đi qua giữa hai nửa của nó. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho họ giống như con bò con ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 내 언약을 어기고, 그들이 송아지를 둘로 쪼개어 그 사이로 지나가면서 내 앞에서 맺은 언약의 말을 지키지 않은 사람들을, 내가 그 [송아지처럼] 만들겠다.
ko.B: 내 언약을 어기고, 송아지를 둘로 쪼개어 그 사이로 지나가며 내 앞에서 맺은 언약의 조항을 지키지 않은 사람들을, 내가 그 송아지처럼 만들겠다.
ko.R: 이 사람들은 내 언약을 어겼다. 그들은 송아지를 둘로 쪼개어 그 사이로 지나가면서 내 앞에서 약속을 했지만, 그 약속을 지키지 않았다. 그러니 내가 그들을 그 송아지처럼 만들겠다.

pt.L: E farei {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} que transgrediram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança, que não cumpriram as palavras da aliança que fizeram diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, [como] o bezerro que cortaram em dois e passaram entre as suas partes,
pt.B: Quanto {{gender:às pessoas|aos homens}} que quebraram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança e não cumpriram os termos da aliança que fizeram diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, eu as farei como o bezerro que cortaram em dois e entre cujas metades passaram,
pt.R: Essas pessoas quebraram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança. Não cumpriram as promessas que fizeram diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} quando cortaram um bezerro em dois e passaram entre as metades. Por isso vou fazer com elas o mesmo que fizeram com aquele bezerro.

am.L: ቃል ኪዳኔንም የተላለፉትን፣ በፊቴም ያደረጉትን የቃል ኪዳኑን ቃል ያልፈጸሙትን ሰዎች፣ ለሁለት እንደ ሰነጠቁትና በክፍሎቹ መካከል እንዳለፉበት ጥጃ አደርጋቸዋለሁ፤
am.B: ቃል ኪዳኔን ያፈረሱትንና በፊቴ ያደረጉትን የቃል ኪዳኑን ቃል ያልጠበቁትን ሰዎች፣ ለሁለት ሰንጥቀው በግማሾቹ መካከል እንዳለፉበት ጥጃ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።
am.R: እነዚህ ሰዎች ቃል ኪዳኔን አፈረሱ። ጥጃውን ለሁለት ሰንጥቀው በግማሾቹ መካከል ባለፉ ጊዜ በፊቴ የገቡትን ቃል አልጠበቁም። ስለዚህ እንደዚያ ጥጃ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

hi.L: और जिन {{gender:लोगों|पुरुषों}} ने मेरी वाचा का उल्लंघन किया, जिन्होंने उस वाचा की बातें पूरी नहीं कीं जो उन्होंने मेरे सामने बाँधी थी, उन्हें मैं उस बछड़े [के समान] कर दूँगा जिसे उन्होंने दो टुकड़े किया और जिसके टुकड़ों के बीच से होकर वे निकले,
hi.B: जिन {{gender:लोगों|पुरुषों}} ने मेरी वाचा तोड़ी और उस वाचा की शर्तें पूरी नहीं कीं जो उन्होंने मेरे सामने बाँधी थी, उन्हें मैं उस बछड़े के समान कर दूँगा जिसे उन्होंने दो टुकड़े किया और जिसके दोनों भागों के बीच से होकर वे चले,
hi.R: इन लोगों ने मेरी वाचा तोड़ी। उन्होंने वे वादे पूरे नहीं किए जो उन्होंने मेरे सामने तब किए थे जब वे एक बछड़े को दो टुकड़े करके उसके दोनों भागों के बीच से होकर चले थे। इसलिए मैं उन्हें उसी बछड़े के समान कर दूँगा।

ru.L: И сделаю {{gender:людей|мужей}}, преступивших {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет, не исполнивших слов завета, который они заключили передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}, [подобными] тельцу, которого они рассекли надвое и прошли между его частями,
ru.B: А с {{gender:людьми|мужами}}, которые нарушили {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет и не исполнили условий завета, заключённого ими передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поступлю так же, как с тельцом, которого они рассекли надвое и прошли между его половинами,
ru.R: Эти люди нарушили {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет. Они не исполнили обещаний, которые дали передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}, когда разрубили телёнка надвое и прошли между его половинами. Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделаю с ними то же, что сделали с этим телёнком.

ja.L: わたしは、わたしの契約を破った人々、わたしの前で結んだ契約の言葉を果たさなかった人々を、彼らが二つに切り裂いて、その切り裂かれたものの間を通った子牛[のように]する。
ja.B: わたしの契約を破り、わたしの前で結んだ契約の条項を守らなかった人々を、わたしは、彼らが二つに切り裂いてその間を通った子牛のようにする。
ja.R: この人々は、わたしの契約を破った。子牛を二つに切り裂いて、その間を通り、わたしの前で約束したのに、その約束を守らなかった。だから、わたしは彼らを、その子牛のようにする。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зроблю {{gender:людей|мужів}}, які переступили {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт, які не виконали слів завіту, що уклали переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}, [як] теля, яке вони розтяли надвоє і пройшли між його частинами,
uk.B: А {{gender:людей|мужів}}, які порушили {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт і не дотрималися умов завіту, що уклали переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зроблю подібними до теляти, яке вони розтяли надвоє і пройшли між його половинами,
uk.R: Ці люди порушили {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт. Вони не дотрималися обіцянок, які дали переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}, коли розтяли теля надвоє і пройшли між половинами. Тож {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зроблю їх подібними до того теляти.

id.L: Dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan membuat orang-orang yang telah melanggar perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, yang tidak menepati perkataan perjanjian yang telah mereka adakan di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, [seperti] anak lembu yang mereka potong menjadi dua dan mereka lewati di antara potongan-potongannya,
id.B: Orang-orang yang telah melanggar perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} dan tidak menepati isi perjanjian yang mereka adakan di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} akan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} buat seperti anak lembu yang mereka potong menjadi dua dan mereka lewati di antara kedua belahannya,
id.R: Orang-orang ini telah melanggar perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Mereka tidak menepati janji yang mereka buat di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} ketika mereka memotong seekor anak sapi menjadi dua dan berjalan di antara kedua belahannya. Karena itu {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan membuat mereka seperti anak sapi itu.

tl.L: At gagawin ko ang mga taong lumabag sa aking tipan, na hindi tumupad sa mga salita ng tipang ginawa nila sa harap ko, na gaya ng guya na hinati nila sa dalawa at dinaanan ang pagitan ng mga bahagi nito,
tl.B: Ang mga taong lumabag sa aking tipan at hindi tumupad sa mga tadhana ng tipang ginawa nila sa harap ko, ay gagawin kong gaya ng guya na hinati nila sa dalawa at dinaanan ang pagitan ng mga kalahati nito,
tl.R: Nilabag ng mga taong ito ang aking tipan. Hindi nila tinupad ang mga pangakong ginawa nila sa harap ko nang hatiin nila sa dalawa ang isang guya at dumaan sa pagitan ng mga kalahati nito. Kaya gagawin ko silang gaya ng guyang iyon.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ {{gender:ਲੋਕਾਂ|ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ}} ਨੂੰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਨੇਮ ਦੀ ਉਲੰਘਣਾ ਕੀਤੀ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੇਮ ਦੀਆਂ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਨਾ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿਆ ਸੀ, ਉਸ ਵੱਛੇ [ਵਰਗਾ] ਕਰ ਦਿਆਂਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਦੋ ਟੋਟੇ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਟੋਟਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਲੰਘੇ,
pa.B: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ {{gender:ਲੋਕਾਂ|ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ}} ਨੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੇਮ ਤੋੜਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਬੰਨ੍ਹੇ ਨੇਮ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਨਿਭਾਈਆਂ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਵੱਛੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਕਰ ਦਿਆਂਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਚੀਰ ਕੇ ਦੋ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਅੱਧਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਲੰਘੇ,
pa.R: ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੇਮ ਤੋੜਿਆ। ਜਦ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਇੱਕ ਵੱਛੇ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਢ ਕੇ ਦੋ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਦੋਹਾਂ ਅੱਧਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਲੰਘੇ, ਤਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਵਾਅਦੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਸਨ, ਪਰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਨਿਭਾਇਆ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਉਸ ਵੱਛੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਹਾਲ ਕਰਾਂਗਾ।

zh.L: 我要使那些违背我约的{{gender:人|男人}}，就是不遵行他们在我面前所立之约的话的，[像]他们劈成两半、又从两半中间经过的那头牛犊，
zh.B: 至于那些违背我的约、不遵守他们在我面前所立之约的条款的{{gender:人|男人}}，我要使他们像他们劈成两半、从中间走过的那头牛犊一样，
zh.R: 这些人违背了我的约。他们曾在我面前把一头牛犊劈成两半，从两半中间走过，可是他们没有遵守那时所作的承诺。所以我要使他们像那头牛犊一样。

decisions.choice: the calf cut in two: a rite of oath-taking
decisions.reason: Those who made the covenant cut a young bull in two, laid out the halves, and walked between them. By doing so they called down on themselves the fate of the animal if they broke their word: may it be done to me as to this calf. The same rite lies behind Genesis 15:9-17, where Abram lays out the halves of the animals and the LORD, as a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch, passes between the pieces to seal his covenant.

decisions.choice: I will make the people ... like the calf
alternatives: I will give the men ... (over to their enemies, verse 20); the calf names the covenant rite
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "I will give the men ... the calf", with no word for "like". The verse is taken as saying that the LORD will make them like the calf they cut: they will suffer the fate they called down on themselves (verse 20). Another reading joins "the calf" to the covenant ("the covenant they made before me, the calf that they cut"), but then "I will give the men" has no completion until verse 20.

decisions.choice: transgressed ... passed: one Hebrew verb; made ... cut: another
decisions.reason: The verb for "transgress" also means "pass over" or "pass through": those who passed between the halves of the calf have passed over the covenant. And the Hebrew for "making" a covenant is "cutting" one, the word used for cutting the calf. The rite and the sin are told in the same words.

decisions.choice: [like] (L); like (B)
decisions.reason: The word is supplied to make sense of the sentence (m2). Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: three sentences, with the judgment last
decisions.reason: Readable tells first what the people did and then what the LORD will do.

decisions.choice: {{gender:las personas|los hombres}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "men" here means everyone who passed between the halves, listed in verse 19, so the inclusive wording is the default, as the English has it.

decisions.choice: ndama ... vipande viwili
decisions.reason: The rite of the cut calf is kept at every level as the English does; walking between the halves called the same fate down on oath-breakers (meaning decisions).

decisions.choice: "les gens", with "les hommes" as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: As the English: those who took the oath are named by a word that means the people, so the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: "những người" (the people) with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "những người" already means the people of both sexes, so the English gender setting has no second Vietnamese wording; the list of verse 19 names them.

decisions.choice: "사람들", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "사람들" already includes everyone, so Korean has no second wording for the English gender setting.

decisions.choice: The rite of the calf placed inside the description of the people, and "make them like the calf" last
decisions.reason: Korean puts relative clauses before their noun and the main verb last, so the judgment closes the verse (meaning decision m2); Readable breaks it into sentences as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}}; eu as farei (B)
decisions.reason: The covenant-breakers are the whole people, men and women (verse 19), so the setting follows the English. At Balanced the pronoun that refers back, "as", agrees with the default "pessoas"; with the traditional "homens" a reader would expect "os", a small mismatch the setting cannot avoid.

decisions.choice: transgrediram ... passaram (L); fizeram (cut)
decisions.reason: Portuguese cannot keep the Hebrew play of one verb for "transgress" and "pass" (m3); Literal keeps "transgredir", whose Latin root is "pass across", and "passar" for the rite.

decisions.choice: "የተላለፉ ... አለፉ" for the one Hebrew verb ʿavar, transgressed and passed
decisions.reason: Amharic "አለፈ / ተላለፈ" carries the same play the meaning decision notes: they passed between the halves and passed over the covenant.

decisions.choice: {{gender:लोगों|पुरुषों}}
decisions.reason: The English gives "the people / the men" as a gender setting; Hindi has the same two wordings, so the span is kept. Readable says लोग, as the English Readable has no span.

decisions.choice: दो टुकड़े करना; टुकड़ों के बीच से होकर निकलना
decisions.reason: The oath rite echoes Genesis 15:10, whose Literal uses दो टुकड़े करना in this translation.

decisions.choice: {{gender:людей|мужей}} (L); {{gender:людьми|мужами}} (B)
decisions.reason: The gender setting follows the English: those who broke the covenant were the people of verse 19, men and women; "мужи" is the traditional alternative.

decisions.choice: телец (L, B); телёнок (R); рассекли надвое и прошли между частями
decisions.reason: The rite of oath-taking (meaning m1) in words close to Genesis 15:17 in this translation, where the torch passes between the parts. Readable uses the everyday word for a calf.

decisions.choice: ha'anashim "人々" with no gender span: the Japanese is already inclusive, where the English has {{gender:the people|the men}}.
decisions.reason: Style guide §7a: gender spans the English needs and Japanese does not.

decisions.choice: "[のように]" (L), "のように" (B, R) as the English, for the comparison the Hebrew leaves unsaid; 'avar "破る / 通る" and karat "結ぶ / 切り裂く" by sense (the Hebrew plays on each pair).
decisions.reason: m2 (uncertain; footnoted), m3.

decisions.choice: "orang-orang" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Indonesian "orang" is already inclusive; the English span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: "guya na hinati nila sa dalawa"
decisions.reason: The calf cut in two: a rite of oath-taking (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:ਲੋਕਾਂ|ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ}}
decisions.reason: Gender span for 'the men'.

decisions.choice: ਦੋ ਟੋਟੇ ਕਰਨਾ (L), ਦੋ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਕਰਨਾ (B, R); ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਲੰਘਣਾ
decisions.reason: The covenant rite.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:人|男人}}" (L, B)
decisions.reason: As the English gender span: the people who broke the covenant, men and women, by default; "男人" for readers who choose the traditional wording. Readable says "这些人" with no span, as its English does.

decisions.choice: "劈成两半……从两半中间经过"
decisions.reason: The rite of oath-taking (m1): those who swore walked between the halves, calling the same fate on themselves. Every level keeps the picture so that the threat is understood.

source.text: שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וְשָׂרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הַסָּֽרִסִים֙ וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וְכֹ֖ל עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ הָעֹ֣בְרִ֔ים בֵּ֖ין בִּתְרֵ֥י הָעֵֽגֶל׃

records.literal_gloss: [the] princes of Judah and [the] princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs and the priests and all [the] people of the land, the [ones] passing between [the] parts of the calf;

en.L: the princes of Judah and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs and the priests and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf;
en.B: that is, the officials of Judah and the officials of Jerusalem, the court officers, the priests and all the people of the land who walked between the halves of the calf.
en.R: These were the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the palace officials, the priests and all the people of the land. They had all walked between the halves of the calf.

es.L: a los príncipes de Judá y a los príncipes de Jerusalén, a los eunucos y a los sacerdotes y a todo el pueblo de la tierra, que pasaron entre las mitades del becerro;
es.B: es decir, a los jefes de Judá y a los jefes de Jerusalén, a los funcionarios de la corte, a los sacerdotes y a todo el pueblo de la tierra que pasaron entre las mitades del becerro.
es.R: Eran los dirigentes de Judá y de Jerusalén, los funcionarios del palacio, los sacerdotes y toda la gente del país. Todos ellos habían pasado entre las mitades del becerro.

fr.L: les princes de Juda et les princes de Jérusalem, les eunuques, et les prêtres, et tout le peuple du pays, qui sont passés entre les morceaux du veau ;
fr.B: c’est-à-dire les chefs de Juda et les chefs de Jérusalem, les hauts fonctionnaires, les prêtres et tout le peuple du pays qui sont passés entre les moitiés du veau.
fr.R: C’étaient les chefs de Juda et de Jérusalem, les fonctionnaires du palais, les prêtres et tous les gens du pays. Ils étaient tous passés entre les moitiés du veau.

sw.L: wakuu wa Yuda na wakuu wa Yerusalemu, matowashi na makuhani na watu wote wa nchi, waliopita kati ya vipande vya ndama;
sw.B: yaani maafisa wa Yuda na maafisa wa Yerusalemu, maafisa wa ikulu, makuhani na watu wote wa nchi waliotembea katikati ya nusu za ndama.
sw.R: Hawa walikuwa viongozi wa Yuda na Yerusalemu, maafisa wa ikulu, makuhani na watu wote wa nchi. Wote walikuwa wametembea katikati ya nusu za ndama.

vi.L: là các quan trưởng Giu-đa và các quan trưởng Giê-ru-sa-lem, các hoạn quan, các thầy tế lễ và toàn dân trong xứ, là những người đã đi qua giữa các phần của con bò con;
vi.B: tức là các quan chức Giu-đa và các quan chức Giê-ru-sa-lem, các quan chức trong cung, các thầy tế lễ và toàn dân trong xứ, là những người đã đi qua giữa hai nửa con bò con.
vi.R: Đó là các nhà lãnh đạo của Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, các quan chức trong cung, các thầy tế lễ và toàn dân trong xứ. Tất cả họ đã đi qua giữa hai nửa con bò con.

ko.L: 곧 송아지의 쪼갠 조각들 사이로 지나간 유다의 고관들과 예루살렘의 고관들과 내시들과 제사장들과 그 땅의 모든 백성이다.
ko.B: 곧 송아지의 쪼갠 조각 사이로 지나간 유다의 관리들과 예루살렘의 관리들과 왕궁 관리들과 제사장들과 그 땅의 모든 백성이다.
ko.R: 그들은 유다와 예루살렘의 지도자들과 왕궁 관리들과 제사장들과 그 땅의 모든 백성이다. 그들은 모두 쪼갠 송아지 사이로 지나갔다.

pt.L: os príncipes de Judá e os príncipes de Jerusalém, os eunucos e os sacerdotes e todo o povo da terra, que passaram entre as partes do bezerro;
pt.B: isto é, os oficiais de Judá e os oficiais de Jerusalém, os funcionários da corte, os sacerdotes e todo o povo da terra que passaram entre as metades do bezerro.
pt.R: Eram os líderes de Judá e de Jerusalém, os oficiais do palácio, os sacerdotes e todo o povo da terra. Todos eles tinham passado entre as metades do bezerro.

am.L: በጥጃውም ክፍሎች መካከል ያለፉትን የይሁዳን አለቆችና የኢየሩሳሌምን አለቆች፣ ጃንደረቦቹንና ካህናቱን፣ የምድሪቱንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ፤
am.B: እነርሱም በጥጃው ግማሾች መካከል ያለፉት የይሁዳ ሹማምንትና የኢየሩሳሌም ሹማምንት፣ የቤተ መንግሥቱ ሹሞች፣ ካህናቱና የምድሪቱ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ናቸው።
am.R: እነዚህም የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌም መሪዎች፣ የቤተ መንግሥቱ ባለ ሥልጣኖች፣ ካህናቱና የምድሪቱ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ነበሩ። ሁሉም በጥጃው ግማሾች መካከል አልፈው ነበር።

hi.L: यहूदा के हाकिम और यरूशलेम के हाकिम, खोजे और याजक और देश के सब लोग, जो बछड़े के टुकड़ों के बीच से होकर निकले;
hi.B: अर्थात यहूदा के अधिकारी और यरूशलेम के अधिकारी, दरबारी, याजक और देश के सब लोग जो बछड़े के दोनों भागों के बीच से होकर चले।
hi.R: ये यहूदा और यरूशलेम के अगुवे, महल के कर्मचारी, याजक और देश के सब लोग थे। ये सब बछड़े के दोनों भागों के बीच से होकर चले थे।

ru.L: князей Иуды и князей Иерусалима, евнухов, и священников, и весь народ земли, прошедших между частями тельца,
ru.B: то есть с вельможами Иуды и вельможами Иерусалима, с придворными, священниками и всем народом страны, которые прошли между половинами тельца.
ru.R: Это были начальники Иуды и Иерусалима, придворные, священники и весь народ страны. Все они прошли между половинами телёнка.

ja.L: すなわち、子牛の切り裂かれたものの間を通った、ユダの長たち、エルサレムの長たち、宦官たち、祭司たち、国の民のすべてである。
ja.B: すなわち、ユダの高官たち、エルサレムの高官たち、宮廷の役人たち、祭司たち、そして子牛の切り裂かれた半分の間を通った国の民すべてである。
ja.R: それは、ユダとエルサレムの指導者たち、王宮の役人たち、祭司たち、そして国中の人々だ。彼らはみな、子牛の切り裂かれた半分の間を通ったのだ。

uk.L: князів Юдеї і князів Єрусалима, євнухів, і священників, і весь народ землі, які пройшли між частинами теляти;
uk.B: тобто вельмож Юдеї та вельмож Єрусалима, придворних урядовців, священників і весь народ землі, що пройшли між половинами теляти.
uk.R: Це були провідники Юдеї та Єрусалима, палацові урядовці, священники й увесь народ землі. Усі вони пройшли між половинами теляти.

id.L: para pembesar Yehuda dan para pembesar Yerusalem, para sida-sida dan para imam dan seluruh rakyat negeri, yang telah lewat di antara potongan-potongan anak lembu itu;
id.B: yaitu para pembesar Yehuda dan para pembesar Yerusalem, para pegawai istana, para imam dan seluruh rakyat negeri yang telah lewat di antara kedua belahan anak lembu itu.
id.R: Mereka itu ialah para pemimpin Yehuda dan Yerusalem, para pegawai istana, para imam dan seluruh rakyat negeri. Mereka semua telah berjalan di antara kedua belahan anak sapi itu.

tl.L: ang mga pinuno ng Juda at ang mga pinuno ng Jerusalem, ang mga eunuko at ang mga pari at ang buong bayan ng lupain, na dumaan sa pagitan ng mga bahagi ng guya;
tl.B: ibig sabihin, ang mga opisyal ng Juda at ang mga opisyal ng Jerusalem, ang mga tagapaglingkod sa palasyo, ang mga pari at ang buong bayan ng lupain na dumaan sa pagitan ng mga kalahati ng guya.
tl.R: Sila ang mga pinuno ng Juda at ng Jerusalem, ang mga opisyal ng palasyo, ang mga pari at ang buong bayan ng lupain. Dumaan silang lahat sa pagitan ng mga kalahati ng guya.

pa.L: ਯਹੂਦਾਹ ਦੇ ਹਾਕਮ ਅਤੇ ਯਰੂਸ਼ਲਮ ਦੇ ਹਾਕਮ, ਖੋਜੇ ਅਤੇ ਜਾਜਕ ਅਤੇ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ, ਜਿਹੜੇ ਵੱਛੇ ਦੇ ਟੋਟਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਲੰਘੇ ਸਨ;
pa.B: ਅਰਥਾਤ ਯਹੂਦਾਹ ਦੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਯਰੂਸ਼ਲਮ ਦੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ, ਦਰਬਾਰੀ, ਜਾਜਕ ਅਤੇ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਵੱਛੇ ਦੇ ਅੱਧਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਲੰਘੇ ਸਨ।
pa.R: ਇਹ ਯਹੂਦਾਹ ਅਤੇ ਯਰੂਸ਼ਲਮ ਦੇ ਆਗੂ, ਮਹਿਲ ਦੇ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀ, ਜਾਜਕ ਅਤੇ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਨ। ਉਹ ਸਭ ਵੱਛੇ ਦੇ ਅੱਧਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਲੰਘੇ ਸਨ।

zh.L: 就是犹大的首领、耶路撒冷的首领、宦官、祭司和国中所有的百姓，就是从牛犊两半中间经过的人；
zh.B: 也就是犹大的官员、耶路撒冷的官员、宦官、祭司和国中所有的百姓，他们都从牛犊的两半中间走过。
zh.R: 这些人就是犹大和耶路撒冷的领袖、王宫里的官员、祭司和国中所有的百姓。他们都从牛犊的两半中间走过。

decisions.choice: eunuchs: royal court officers, perhaps castrated men
decisions.reason: The word names a class of officers at the king's court. Many such officers in the courts of the ancient Near East were castrated, but the word is also used of high officials who were not, so here it may mean palace officials in general (compare 29:2; 38:7; 2 Kings 24:12).

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the free landowning citizens of Judah
decisions.reason: The phrase names the ordinary citizens of the land, as against the court and the priests, who often stood together on matters of state (2 Kings 11:14; 23:30). Every class of the nation took part in the oath.

decisions.choice: a list naming the people of verse 18
decisions.reason: The verse says who the covenant-breakers were. The sentence goes on in verse 20 with what the LORD will do to them.

decisions.choice: princes, eunuchs (L); officials, court officers (B); leaders, palace officials (R)
decisions.reason: Two words for the king's court stand side by side, as in 2 Kings 24:12. Balanced uses "officials" for the princes as usual and calls the eunuchs "court officers" to keep the groups apart; Readable has "leaders" and "palace officials".

decisions.choice: that is (B); These were (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add a few words to show that the list names the people of verse 18.

decisions.choice: "내시들" (L); "왕궁 관리들" (B, R) for *sarisim*
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for *saris*: "내시" at Literal and an official's title at Balanced and Readable; "관리" alone is kept for *sar* here, so Balanced says "왕궁 관리들".

decisions.choice: príncipes, eunucos (L); oficiais, funcionários da corte (B); líderes, oficiais do palácio (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 29:2; 38:7; 41:16; 52:25), as 2 Kings 24:12 has these court officers in Portuguese: "eunucos" at Literal and "funcionários da corte" at Balanced, so as not to repeat "oficiais", which Balanced keeps for the sarim (1:18); Readable says "oficiais do palácio". The sarim keep the forms 1:18 sets.

decisions.choice: saris "ጃንደረባ" (Literal), "የቤተ መንግሥቱ ሹም" (Balanced), "ባለ ሥልጣን" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Kings terms list gives ጃንደረባ / ሹም; "የቤተ መንግሥቱ" keeps the court officers apart from the sarim, "ሹማምንት", in the same verse.

decisions.choice: हाकिम, खोजे (L); अधिकारी, दरबारी (B); अगुवे, महल के कर्मचारी (R)
decisions.reason: The two words for the king's court keep the forms of 2 Kings 24:12 at each level: saris is खोजा (L), दरबारी (B), महल के कर्मचारी (R).

decisions.choice: князья, евнухи (L); вельможи, придворные (B); начальники, придворные (R)
decisions.reason: Two words for the king's court stand side by side, as in 2 Kings 24:12 and 24:15, and keep the forms used there in this translation: евнухи at Literal, придворные at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: hassarisim "宦官たち" (L), "宮廷の役人たち" (B), "王宮の役人たち" (R); 'am ha'arets "国の民" (L, B), "国中の人々" (R).
decisions.reason: m1, m2; the 2 Kings 24:12 forms.

decisions.choice: "sida-sida" (L), "pegawai istana" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The glossary's words, as 29:2 (m1).

decisions.choice: "eunuko"
decisions.reason: Eunuchs: royal court officers (m1).

decisions.choice: ਹਾਕਮ, ਖੋਜੇ (L); ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ, ਦਰਬਾਰੀ (B); ਆਗੂ, ਮਹਿਲ ਦੇ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀ (R)
decisions.reason: Officials and court officers.

decisions.choice: "宦官" (L, B); "王宫里的官员" (R); "国中所有的百姓" (every level)
decisions.reason: The glossary's words for the court officers (saris) and for "the people of the land" (as 2 Chronicles 33:25).
